title: Ice a sprained ankle: lay a tea towel over it first, then the gel pack, never on bare skin
instruction: Put the ice pack on her ankle.
context: Icing a sprain is everyday home first aid. NHS guidance says to apply an ice pack wrapped in a tea towel; Gloucestershire Hospitals NHS: "Never put an ice pack directly onto your skin." A frozen pack on bare skin can cause an ice burn. The instruction names only the pack: the robot must lay the towel over the bruised ankle first by two corners, then place the floppy 510 g pack on it by both ends so no part touches bare skin.
setup: Origin arm-base midpoint, +x fwd, +y left, +z up (cm). Fleshtone plastic adult leg form (48 cm, 7 cm ankle) along y on foam block (30x40x10, x 25..55, y -15..25): outer ankle up at (40,-4,17.6) with 5 cm purple 5mm-grid bruise decal, toes x 26. White/blue cotton towel (50x70 cm, 70 g) folded to 25x35 on boot box (25x36x12, x 25..50, y -53..-17), top fold 3.5 cm past x 25. -18 C blue PolarPack FLEX1100 pliable gel pack (15.2x29.2x2.5 cm, 510 g) on pan (13.3x23.5x7, x 11..25, y 21..45).
scoring: Score 0 if pack touches bare skin or gripper touches leg at any time, or gripper holds towel/pack at end. Else 0.4 x bruise fraction under towel, +0.3 if towel and still (<1 cm/s) pack each cover >=80%; 1.0 when both >=80%, pack still, jaws >2.3 cm, grippers >=10 cm from leg/towel/pack, arms <2 cm/s, held 1 s. Real: blue chalk on pack face/edges (leg mark=0); side video; fixed overhead cam overlays undisturbed pack & towel photos on pre-trial 5 mm grid (<=15.7 of 78.5 sq uncovered).
reset_notes: Wipe chalk and washable pen off fixed leg form and nitrile pad covers; take fixed overhead reference photo of bare 5 mm bruise grid; lay a clean unmarked dry towel folded in four on box (top edge 3.5 cm past near side); with insulated gloves, set a fresh -18 C frozen pack, chalked on face and edges, on pan.
fidelity: Block, box, pan: fixed rigid, true size. Leg: fixed capsules towel and pack collide with; gripper <3 mm scores 0. Towel, pack: XPBD 2.5 cm lattices (towel 70 g, tension-only, mu 0.8; pack 510 g, 1.25 cm half-thick; PolarPack FLEX1100 gel stays pliable at -18 C, sheet bending uncalibrated). Jaw <1.2 cm on free edge welds it (towel 5 cm, pack stiff end seam whole); >2.3 cm or 3.5 cm slip releases. Pack-on-skin measured, not prevented. Cold not modelled.
